items.title: Caitlin Clark delivers in home playoff debut as Fever force Game 3
items.body_excerpt: The 3-pointers. The dazzling passes. The fiery passion. It’s all part of the Caitlin Clark experience. It was on April 15, 2024 when the Indiana Fever made it official, selecting Caitlin Clark No. 1 overall . It was an easy decision by the franchise, but one it had to wait…
